limitations: This is one automated Chromium run on macOS, not a stable browser matrix.
The Playwright Desktop Chrome descriptor supplies the recorded user agent; the launched executable reports Chromium 151.0.7922.34.
Touch is browser emulation rather than a physical phone or tablet.

The popup is a controlled same-origin portal-coupled fixture; Document Picture-in-Picture, multi-screen placement, process crash, arbitrary application renderers, and cross-origin deployment are not covered.
Automated axe, forced-colors, and keyboard checks do not replace manual assistive-technology assessment.
